mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates applied to future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS increases by at least 0.25 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% and rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that triggers immediate equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% with a 0.5pp monthly increase.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1500 thousand units) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months meeting the UNRATE < 3.5% and HOUST > 1500 condition.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 700,000 million dollars, it signals robust economic activity that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenues are expected to grow.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when RSAFS > 700000.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past month indicates a tightening labor market that typically leads to higher wage growth and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index base 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting the INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months condition.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising FEDFUNDS (above 1.5%) and rising UNRATE (above 3.5%) signals dual stress from monetary policy and labor market conditions, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as stagflation risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and UNRATE > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 105 (index base 2017=100), it signals robust manufacturing activity that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from higher output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO > 105.
